description: Wire transient message/dialog boxes into the capture stack in ff-desktop (Req 27.1-27.3, 27.6, 27.7), using FEAT-001's ScreenModel::redacted(). Add a DialogScreen source that builds a logical ScreenModel from each transient overlay's OWN state (title + body message + field labels/values + list rows + button labels); route active_screen_capture() to return the FRONTMOST dialog's redacted model when an overlay is open and the Context model otherwise (so SNAPSHOT captures the dialog, Req 27.2, from the logical model not an egui grab, Req 27.7); add a direct COPY front-door verb + helper that places the frontmost surface's redacted text on the clipboard WITHOUT the SNAPSHOT screenshot machinery (Req 27.3); and prove a declared-secret field is redacted in the model, the copy text, and the composite while non-secret fields stay copyable (Req 27.4/27.5). Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/dialog_screen.rs with `pub(crate) trait DialogScreen { fn screen_model(&self) -> ff_screen_model::ScreenModel; }`. Add `mod dialog_screen;` to crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/mod.rs.

TDD: write FAILING test `dialog_screen_marks_declared_secret_field` (annotate `// Validates: screen-snapshot-scrm Req 27.1, 27.4, 27.5`) using a #[cfg(test)] synthetic FakeSecretDialog impl DialogScreen -- title + a body message + a plain Field::new("Host","h1") + Field::new("Password","s3cr3t").with_attrs(FieldAttributes::plain().sensitive()) + a "[OK]" button; assert the built model has title/message/button, the password field's attrs.sensitive is true, and the non-secret Host value is present (copyable, 27.5).

Implement DialogScreen::screen_model() builders for the live core overlays, each built from its OWN state struct (NOT egui): reset_bare_confirm (heading + profile rows + Confirm/Cancel), pending_external (body + command string + Run/Cancel), show_unsaved_workspace_dialog (+ active_workspace.name + Save/Discard/Cancel), show_about, show_history_list, show_swap_list, scrm_ui.save_as (SaveAsState name/folder/type fields + Save/Cancel), scrm_ui.replay_picker. Mark any declared-secret field with FieldAttributes::plain().sensitive(). Keep dialog_screen.rs under 400 non-test lines; split into shell/dialog_screen_scrm.rs if it approaches the limit.

Create crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/dialog_capture.rs; add `mod dialog_capture;` to shell/mod.rs. TDD: FAILING test `dialog_open_captures_dialog_not_context_behind` (`// Validates: Req 27.2`) and `no_dialog_open_returns_none` -- on a shell with an open transient dialog (set via the real path, e.g. reset_bare_confirm or pending_external), assert active_dialog_capture() returns Some with the dialog title/body distinct from the POM Context model; with no dialog open it returns None.

Implement `impl WorkbenchShell { pub(super) fn active_dialog_capture(&self) -> Option<ff_screen_model::ScreenModel> }` in dialog_capture.rs: select the frontmost open overlay using the SAME precedence as the modal_open OR-chain in shell/update_input.rs; build its DialogScreen model and return Some(model.redacted()) (redaction applied here so every caller gets the masked model); None when no overlay is open.

Route the capture seam: at the TOP of active_screen_capture() in shell/screen_provider.rs insert `if let Some(m) = self.active_dialog_capture() { return ScreenCapture::Model(Box::new(m)); }` BEFORE the existing `let tab = self.tabs.active_tab(); match tab.kind.tag() { .. }` (leave the KindTag match byte-for-byte unchanged).

TDD: FAILING test `snapshot_text_for_active_captures_frontmost_redacted_dialog` (`// Validates: Req 27.2, 27.4, 27.7`) -- with a secret dialog wired as frontmost (a #[cfg(test)] overlay hook if needed), call the pure snapshot_text_for_active("") and assert the text contains the dialog title + "[REDACTED]" and NOT the secret value. Make it pass (step-6 routing already covers it).

TDD: extend the SnapshotClipboard trait in crates/ff-desktop/src/clipboard_backend.rs with `fn place_text(&mut self, text: &str) -> Result<(), String>` (Windows: open once + CF_UNICODETEXT via unicode_text_bytes; non-Windows: arboard set_text), impl for OsClipboard, record it in FakeClipboard. FAILING test `place_text_offers_text_only` (`// Validates: Req 27.3`).

TDD + implement the direct COPY affordance: FAILING test `copy_places_frontmost_redacted_text_without_screenshot` (`// Validates: Req 27.3, 27.4`) in dialog_capture.rs -- assert the copied text equals the redacted PlainText of the frontmost surface and that self.snapshot.screenshot_requested was NOT set. Implement `pub(super) fn handle_copy(&mut self)`: take active_dialog_capture() else active_screen_capture().into_model(), render redacted PlainText via screen_snapshot::render_snapshot, place via OsClipboard.place_text, set an i18n status. Add the `COPY` arm in shell/commands_ladder_b.rs beside the SNAPSHOT arm: `if upper == "COPY" { self.handle_copy(); return true; }`. Add i18n keys ff-desktop-shell-msg-copy-copied / -no-clipboard in the .ftl next to the existing ff-desktop-shell-msg-scrm-snapshot-* keys.

TDD: full-shell test `full_shell_copy_command_copies_dialog_text` (`// Validates: Req 27.3, 27.4`) via harness_shell -- open a dialog through the real command path, run handle_command("COPY"), assert the copied text is the dialog's redacted text. And `composite_text_flavor_for_dialog_is_redacted` (`// Validates: Req 27.4`) -- the Markdown flavor built from the frontmost secret dialog omits the secret and contains "[REDACTED]". Split dialog_capture tests into shell/dialog_capture_tests.rs if they near ~200 lines.

Context-dialog regression (Req 27.6): run the existing first-Tab focus tests (full_shell_config_first_tab_focuses_filter_field, ..._theme_editor_...) UNCHANGED and confirm they still pass -- this Req only ADDS the transient-overlay binding and must not touch the Context focus/ScreenProvider contract.
Run the scoped trio on both crates, read the logs, commit locally on branch scrm-2e.
Record in findings: the exact frontmost-overlay precedence used, whether a #[cfg(test)] overlay hook was added, and the final dialog_screen.rs line count / any split.
acceptance_criteria: A transient message/notification popup yields a logical ScreenModel of title+message+buttons through the ScreenProvider seam; no dialog text is uncopyable (Req 27.1).

With a dialog open, active_screen_capture() / snapshot_text_for_active() return the DIALOG surface, not the Context behind it (Req 27.2), rendered from the logical model with no egui pixel grab in the text path (Req 27.7).
A new front-door COPY verb places the frontmost surface's text on the clipboard without setting snapshot.screenshot_requested / invoking the screenshot machinery (Req 27.3).

A declared-secret field is redacted ([REDACTED] present, secret value ABSENT) in the model, the direct-copy text, AND the composite Markdown flavor; a non-secret field remains copyable (Req 27.4, 27.5).
The existing Context first-Tab focus/ScreenProvider tests pass unchanged (Req 27.6).
No source .rs over 400 non-test lines; functions ~40 lines; test files split before ~200 lines; ASCII-only; no new dependency; single command dispatch and the one ScreenProvider seam preserved.
findings:
DONE. Transient message/dialog boxes are now bound into the capture stack (Req 27.1-27.7), built ON the existing ScreenProvider seam and single command dispatch -- no second dispatcher, no bespoke intercept, no egui pixel grab for the text model.

Files changed:
- NEW crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/dialog_screen.rs (~130 non-test lines): pub(crate) trait DialogScreen { fn screen_model(&self) -> ScreenModel }, with impls on PendingExternal (external-run confirm), ResetBareTarget (RESET BARE confirm), and SaveAsState (capture-STOP Save-As). Declared-secret fields use FieldAttributes::plain().sensitive(); no LIVE core overlay carries a credential today, so the contract is proven by a #[cfg(test)] FakeSecretDialog.
- NEW crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/dialog_capture.rs (~208 non-test lines): WorkbenchShell::active_dialog_capture() -> Option<ScreenModel> builds the FRONTMOST open overlay's model and returns it .redacted() (single redaction point so SNAPSHOT + COPY + composite flavors all get the masked model). Also builds the shell-flag overlays inline (About, command-history picker, SWAP picker, unsaved-workspace, SCRM replay picker) since they have no self-contained struct. WorkbenchShell::handle_copy() renders the frontmost surface's redacted PlainText and places it via OsClipboard::place_text WITHOUT arming snapshot.screenshot_requested (Req 27.3).
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/mod.rs: added mod dialog_capture; mod dialog_screen;.
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/screen_provider.rs: at the TOP of active_screen_capture() inserted `if let Some(m) = self.active_dialog_capture() { return ScreenCapture::Model(Box::new(m)); }` BEFORE the KindTag match (match left byte-for-byte unchanged).
- crates/ff-desktop/src/clipboard_backend.rs: added SnapshotClipboard::place_text(&mut self, &str) -> Result<(),String>; impl for OsClipboard (Windows: CF_UNICODETEXT via unicode_text_bytes in one open; non-Windows: arboard set_text) and FakeClipboard; added test place_text_offers_text_only.
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_ladder_b.rs: added `if upper == "COPY" { self.handle_copy(); return true; }` beside the SNAPSHOT arm (routed through the single handle_command front door).
- crates/ff-i18n/i18n/{en,de,fr,af}/ff-desktop-shell-status-messages.ftl: added ff-desktop-shell-msg-copy-copied / -no-clipboard beside the existing scrm-snapshot-* keys.
- crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_scrm.rs: added full_shell_copy_command_copies_dialog_text (real RESET BARE command path -> COPY, no screenshot armed) and no_overlay_capture_is_still_the_context_model (Req 27.6 contract preserved).

Frontmost-overlay precedence used (first open wins), mirroring the modal_open OR-chain in shell/update_input.rs then the SCRM overlays: show_about -> show_history_list -> show_swap_list -> show_unsaved_workspace_dialog -> reset_bare_confirm -> pending_external -> scrm_ui.save_as -> scrm_ui.replay_picker. The command palette is deliberately NOT included (not in the step-3 overlay list).

#[cfg(test)] overlay hook: YES -- added a per-thread thread_local TEST_FRONTMOST in dialog_capture.rs's test module, consulted by a single `#[cfg(test)]` branch at the top of frontmost_dialog_model (compiled out of production). No LIVE overlay holds a secret, so this injects a synthetic frontmost secret dialog to prove the redaction path end-to-end (snapshot text + copy text + Markdown composite). If a future dialog carries a credential, keep it in a Field with FieldAttributes::plain().sensitive() (only fields[] are redacted -- title/messages/buttons are not).

Line counts / splits: dialog_screen.rs ~130 non-test, dialog_capture.rs ~208 non-test, clipboard_backend.rs non-test ends at line 388 -- all under 400; no split needed. Note: tests_scrm.rs is a pre-existing 700+ line TEST file (test files are exempt from the 400 non-test-line rule; I appended ~70 test lines to the established scrm test area rather than splitting an unrelated file).

Verification (all scoped, logs read back, verify-by-effect): cargo check -p ff-desktop -p ff-screen-model OK; cargo test -p ff-screen-model redact = 2 passed; cargo test -p ff-desktop -- dialog_capture dialog_screen clipboard_backend screen_provider first_tab = 33 passed (incl. all 15 first_tab focus tests UNCHANGED, Req 27.6); full_shell_copy_command_copies_dialog_text + no_overlay_capture_is_still_the_context_model = 2 passed; cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings clean; cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -p ff-screen-model -- --check clean. No new dependency. Committed locally on branch scrm-2e; not pushed.

Known limitations: (1) handle_copy / place_text write to the REAL OsClipboard and return only a status message, so the exact clipboard bytes are not asserted in a headless test -- the pure tests assert the computed redacted text and FakeClipboard.place_text instead (the OS round-trip is the owner's manual check, same posture as the existing SNAPSHOT picture flavors). (2) Redaction masks only ScreenModel.fields[]; a secret placed in title/messages/buttons would NOT be masked -- keep secrets in sensitive-marked fields. (3) The owner's full `cargo gate` (whole-suite) is the authoritative green run per gate-policy.md; agent verification here is scoped compile+clippy+fmt+focused tests.
